Top 10 applied-AI events, Nov 2026–Jun 2027

By lowob · 26 October 2026 · 4-minute read · Distribution

Heads of applied AI, data and risk at banks, insurers and data firms deciding which events justify the travel budget. Skip it if you want research conferences or startup demo days.

The vendor shows are where the roadmaps are announced. The analyst and finance-specific events are where peers in regulated firms compare what actually works. A balanced year includes one of each.

How we ranked

Criterion Weight
Share of attendees who are senior practitioners in regulated firms 40%
Usefulness of the content for production decisions, not demos 30%
Peer access: side meetings, roundtables, small formats 20%
Cost per useful meeting 10%

The list

Rank Event Dates Where Best for Watch out for
1 Gartner Data & Analytics Summit 8–10 Mar 2027 Gaylord Palms, Orlando Chief data and analytics officers comparing governance and operating models Expensive: $4,475 early, $4,925 standard
2 Money20/20 Europe 8–10 Jun 2027 RAI, Amsterdam Banks and payments leaders on AI in fraud, payments and compliance; the organiser says one in three attendees is C-suite Fintech-first; AI is a track, not the theme
3 AWS re:Invent 30 Nov–4 Dec 2026 Las Vegas Agent infrastructure on AWS, which many data and ratings firms run on 60,000+ people; plan meetings in advance. Pass $2,499
4 Microsoft Ignite 17–20 Nov 2026 Moscone Center, San Francisco Copilot, agent identity and governance for Microsoft 365 shops Prices not published on the site
5 HumanX 8–10 Mar 2027 Mandalay Bay, Las Vegas Chief AI officers and AI security leaders across industries $2,995 early, rising to $3,995; free "Adopter" passes by application
6 Google Cloud Next 13–15 Apr 2027 Mandalay Bay, Las Vegas Gemini Enterprise and Google's new agent memory design Prices not yet published
7 NVIDIA GTC 15–18 Mar 2027 (the FAQ says 14–18) San Jose Infrastructure and on-premises AI for firms that cannot send data out Dates conflict on NVIDIA's own site; confirm before booking
8 Databricks Data + AI Summit 21–24 Jun 2027 Moscone Center, San Francisco Data platform teams on Databricks Platform-specific
9 Snowflake Summit 7–10 Jun 2027 Moscone Center, San Francisco Data platform teams on Snowflake Platform-specific; save-the-date only
10 The AI Summit London 9–10 Jun 2027 Tobacco Dock, London European enterprise AI leaders and policymakers, during London Tech Week The page title says 10–11 June; confirm before booking

Also in the window

Gartner IT Symposium/Xpo Barcelona, 9–12 Nov 2026: CIOs, broader than AI.

Cerebral Valley AI Summit, 12 Nov 2026, San Francisco: invite-only, founder-heavy.

World Economic Forum, Davos, 18–22 Jan 2027: invitation only.

Web Summit Qatar, 31 Jan–3 Feb 2027, and LEAP, 12–15 Apr 2027 near Riyadh: large, general tech.

AI Engineer World's Fair, 29 Jun–1 Jul 2027, San Francisco: builders, starting right at the edge of the window.

Left out, and why

Evident AI Symposium, New York. Probably the closest fit for AI leaders at banks, with more than 110 financial institutions, but it ran on 22 October 2026, just before this window opens.

SIFMA Ops 2027. No dates announced yet; add it when they are.

RAISE Summit Paris. 6–8 July 2027, just outside the window.

How to get value from any of them

  1. Pick one vendor show for your main platform and one peer event. Skip the rest.
  2. Bring one question you need answered for a real decision, and ask it in every meeting.
  3. Write up what you learned within 48 hours, in the same record you use for decisions.

lowob takeaways

  • Ranking weights senior regulated-firm practitioners at 40%, production-relevant content 30%, peer access 20%, and cost per meeting 10%.
  • AWS re:Invent runs 30 Nov–4 Dec 2026 with 60,000+ attendees and a $2,499 pass.
  • Pick one vendor show for your main platform and one peer event, and skip the rest.
